overview_description.description: Badia Farms is an agricultural technology company based in the United Arab Emirates that specializes in vertical farming and controlled-environment agriculture. The company cultivates leafy greens, culinary herbs, edible flowers, and microgreens using hydroponic systems designed to reduce water consumption and support year-round production. Its operations focus on supplying fresh produce to restaurants, hospitality businesses, retailers, and consumers across the region. Badia Farms also emphasizes sustainable farming practices by using locally managed indoor growing environments to minimize reliance on imported produce and traditional farming methods in arid climates.
